meta.name: ai-shaped-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Assess whether your product work is AI-first or AI-shaped. Use when evaluating AI maturity and choosing the next team capability to build.

copy.tagline: 评估产品AI成熟度，指导团队能力建设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在评估产品的AI就绪程度并规划团队能力。
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI maturity of your product and guide team capability building
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are evaluating your product's AI readiness and planning team capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会通过一系列问题评估你的产品团队在 5 个关键 AI 能力上的成熟度，然后给出优先发展的建议。
howto.when: 当你需要评估团队 AI 成熟度、确定下一步优先培养哪个能力时，可以启动这个技能。

say.text: 我想知道下一步该优先提升哪个 AI 能力。
say.note: Claude 会先收集背景，再进行打分。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses your product team's maturity across 5 key AI competencies through adaptive questioning, then recommends which capability to build next.
howto.when_en: Use when evaluating AI maturity and choosing which team capability to develop next, especially if you suspect you're AI-first but want to be AI-shaped.

say_en.text: Assess our team's AI maturity and tell me if we're AI-first or AI-shaped.
I want to know which AI capability we should prioritize next.
say_en.note: Claude gathers context then scores competencies.
